SELECT D.YIELD, C.FINPROD_ID FROM (SELECT MAX(A.EFF_DATE) EDATE, A.CASH_ID, B.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A, FIN_CASH_INFO B WHERE A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE2_C02}
AND A.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY A.CASH_ID,B.FINPROD_ID ) C, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE D WHERE C.CASH_ID = D.CASH_ID AND C.EDATE = D.EFF_DATE
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT T.id,T.text,T.object FROM ( SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as id, NVL(FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR,FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME) AS text, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as object FROM FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL
AND (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')) OR (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
UNION ALL SELECT FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AS id, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as text, null as object FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.BRANCH = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH
FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL
AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
)T ORDER BY T.id
